messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up  ACME insists on SCIM + realtime embeddings for GA. We can't do both and keep the Apr 14 ship. Thoughts?
Vik: Short answer: trade. Ship Core GA, Pilot for realtime + SCIM. Keeps momentum.
Arjun: Eng note: SCIM + audit hooks = ~1 sprint. Realtime embeddings = ~3 sprints + mem pressure. Canary also showed OOMs on embed workers.
Pat: Ops: realtime would need mem-optimized nodes and quotas. Finance needs numbers if we pilot on Dedicated.
Nina: Options: A) Ship Apr 14 Core, offer paid Early Access Pilot for SCIM+realtime. B) Delay GA 2w for SCIM, pilot realtime. C) Delay GA 4w to include both.
Vik: I vote A. Sales can soften ACME with Pilot pricing.
Arjun: A as well. We'll gate realtime behind a feature flag and cap inputs.
Pat: Ops supports Pilot with caps, pending finance OK.
ops-bot: Canary report: branch feature/realtime-embeddings failed in staging at 2024-03-20T18:12:03Z  OOM on embed-worker (input_len=2048).
Nina: Decision: Option A. Actions: Prod update PRD cutlist, Eng remove realtime from GA branch and create Pilot epic, Sales/Legal draft pilot addendum, Ops publish capacity delta. I'll post to #launch-comm and message ACME with the Pilot offer.
Vik: I'll start legal loop.
Arjun: Opening Pilot epic now.
Pat: I'll post capacity and a provisional cost delta by EOD.
